title: Restriction tensor and unit comparisons descend to common stages
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k)$ and an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-pur-conventions]. Let $f:Y\to X$ be a morphism of finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], using the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Use the raw rational categories $D^b_c(W,E)$ [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi] and raw common-stage pair categories [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], for $W=X,Y$ and finite intermediate fields $E\subset\Omega$ [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set]. Write $r_E=Lf_E^*$, $S^W_{L/E}=-\otimes_EL$, $b_{L/E}:S^Y_{L/E}r_E\xrightarrow{\sim}r_LS^X_{L/E}$, and $\theta^W_{L/E}:S^W_{L/E}(M\otimes_E^LN)\xrightarrow{\sim}S^W_{L/E}M\otimes_L^LS^W_{L/E}N$. Use exactly the rationalized comparisons of [lem-pur-integral-operations-scalar-extension], with the identity and tower comparisons of [lem-weil-scalar-extension-composition]. Suppose $\mu_{E,M,N}:r_E(M\otimes_E^LN)\xrightarrow{\sim}r_EM\otimes_E^Lr_EN$ are natural isomorphisms and $\epsilon_E:r_E\mathbf1_{E,X}\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathbf1_{E,Y}$ are unit isomorphisms, where $\mathbf1_{E,W}$ is the rationalized completed coefficient unit [def-pur-integral-derived-operations]. Assume scalar-unit comparisons $\upsilon^W_{L/E}:S^W_{L/E}\mathbf1_{E,W}\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathbf1_{L,W}$ and the mixed squares
$$(b_M\otimes b_N)\circ\theta^Y_{r_EM,r_EN}\circ S^Y_{L/E}(\mu_{E,M,N})
=\mu_{L,S^X_{L/E}M,S^X_{L/E}N}\circ r_L(\theta^X_{M,N})\circ b_{M\otimes_E^LN},$$
$$\upsilon^Y_{L/E}\circ S^Y_{L/E}(\epsilon_E)=\epsilon_L\circ r_L(\upsilon^X_{L/E})\circ b_{\mathbf1_{E,X}}.$$
Here every suppressed comparison index is $L/E$. Use the canonical coefficient-unit scalar identifications of [lem-weil-constant-coefficient-objects-constructible] for $\upsilon^W_{L/E}$.

Let $r_\Omega(E,K)=(E,r_EK)$ with arrow action by conjugation with $b$, and use the common-stage tensor of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. There is a natural isomorphism
$$\mu_\Omega:r_\Omega(A\otimes B)\xrightarrow{\sim}r_\Omega(A)\otimes r_\Omega(B).$$
For $A=(E,M)$, $B=(F,N)$, $H=EF$, $M_H=M\otimes_EH$ and $N_H=N\otimes_FH$, its component is represented at $H$ by
$$(b_{H/E,M}^{-1}\otimes_H^Lb_{H/F,N}^{-1})\circ\mu_{H,M_H,N_H}.$$
At every further common field it is the same class under the canonical tensor and scalar-tower comparisons, not a literal identification of objects at different stages. These representatives are independent of the common field and natural for arbitrary common-stage arrows, including the conjugations by $\theta$ in the tensor arrow formula. The classes of $\epsilon_E$ give the restriction comparison for the coefficient unit, compatibly with the scalar-unit identifications. Identities, composition and every specified finite-stage structural equation between these comparisons remain valid on common-stage classes. No idempotent completion or full-faithfulness hypothesis is used.
